# Pipeline Contract

This file is the single contract for the seven-agent remediation pipeline. Agent and skill prose
must defer to it when describing workload eligibility, status transitions, output ownership, or
release authority.

## Ownership

| Agent | Reads | Writes |
|---|---|---|
| `01_architect` | Source and Maven metadata | `01-architecture/` and the knowledge graph |
| `02_root-cause-analyst` | Issue register and architecture outputs | `02-root-cause/` |
| `03_blast-radius-analyst` | Root-cause reports and architecture outputs | `03-blast-radius/` |
| `04_fix-generator` | Root-cause reports, optional blast-radius reports, issue rows | `04-remediation/` |
| `05_existing-app-test-agent` | Drafted fixes and their evidence chain | `05-verify/` |
| `06_additional-test-execution` | Drafted fixes and test material | `06-test-gate/` |
| `07_audit-and-pr` | All verification and gate outputs | `07-ship/` |

`00-issues/issue-register.xlsx` is read-only input. Consumers access it through
`00-issue-register`; no agent or skill edits it.

## Status Transitions

```text
Root cause report
  -> Proposed plan
  -> Approved plan (human only)
  -> Compiled | Compile Failed | Refused fix
  -> verification, QA, and build reports
  -> Cleared | Blocked verdict
  -> optional published PR (Cleared plus explicit user request only)
```

`Compiled` and `Compile Failed` are both drafted fixes and are eligible for static verification,
the QA gate, and the build gate. `Refused` is not eligible because no diff exists.

## Stage 2 Routing (Fix Type)

Every plan rendered by `04a` carries one **Fix Type**, classified by
`04a-fix-strategist/scripts/lib/routing.js` from the strategy and the build descriptor on disk:

| Fix Type | Stage 2 skill | When |
|---|---|---|
| `CODE_FIX` | `04b-fixer` | a code change for the diagnosed defect |
| `DEPENDENCY_UPGRADE` | `04c-dependency-upgrader` | one coordinate bumped to a fixed version (`CWE-1104`) |
| `VERSION_MIGRATION` | `04d-version-migration` | the platform parent/BOM crosses a major generation and/or the Java level changes |

All three write the same `fix_<id>.md` + `fix_<id>.diff` handoff with the same Status vocabulary, so
05–07 consume them identically. A `VERSION_MIGRATION` handoff additionally carries `Fix Type`,
`Migration Status` (`PASS` | `PARTIAL PASS` | `FAIL` | `BLOCKED`), `Source/Target Version`,
`Target Java`, and links to the migration report, diff and per-run summary under
`04-remediation/migration-runs/<run_id>/`. 04D's own result never clears a patch: 05–07 validate it
independently, and `07a` blocks a migration whose Migration Status is not `PASS`/`PARTIAL PASS`.

## Decision Policy

- `STILL_VULNERABLE` and build `Failed` are hard gates and compute `Blocked`.
- The merge arbiter may only override a computed `Cleared` to `Blocked`; it can never clear a
  computed `Blocked` result.
- A `Cleared` verdict is the only release authorization in the pipeline.
- Creating or pushing a PR requires both a `Cleared` verdict and an explicit user request. The
  publisher must apply the rendered fix diff and re-run the relevant validation in an isolated
  worktree before creating the branch and PR.

## Output Ownership

- `04-remediation/README.md` is jointly regenerated by `04a` and `04b` with one shared marker; `04d`
  maintains its own self-delimited migration block in the same file.
- `04-remediation/migration_<slug>.{md,diff}` and `04-remediation/migration-runs/` are written only by
  `04d-version-migration`.
- `05-verify/README.md` is regenerated by the verification renderers with one shared marker.
- `06-test-gate/README.md` is jointly regenerated by `06a` and `06b` with one shared marker.
- `07-ship/README.md` is generated only by `07b-scribe`.
- Reports under `docs/agent_output/VULNERABILITY_REMEDIATION_SUMMARY.md` are historical. Do not
  rewrite their original path references during routine operational updates.
